sentences.en: He looks young, but in reality he is past thirty.
sentences.zh: 他看起来年轻，但实际上他已经三十多岁了。

sentences.en: He is prime minister in name, but not in reality.
sentences.zh: 他是名义上的首相，但并不是实际上的首相。

sentences.en: He took the reality of the situation lightly and failed.
sentences.zh: 他对实际情况轻视，结果失败了。

senses.zh: 现实，现实性,真实情况，实际情形,实体，实在,事实
